package io.github.keheck.tree;  
  
import javax.swing.tree.MutableTreeNode;  
import javax.swing.tree.TreeNode;  
import java.util.Collections;  
import java.util.Enumeration;  
import java.util.Vector;  
  
public class NavTreeFolder extends AbstractNavTreeNode  
{  
    private Vector<TreeNode> offspring;  
    private MutableTreeNode guardian;  
    private Object user;  
  
    public NavTreeFolder(NodeType type, String title)  
    {  
        super(type, title);  
        offspring = new Vector<>();  
    }  
  
    @Override  
    public TreeNode getChildAt(int childIndex) { return offspring.get(childIndex); }  
  
    @Override  
    public int getChildCount() { return offspring.size(); }  
  
    @Override  
    public int getIndex(TreeNode node) { return offspring.indexOf(node); }  
  
    @Override  
    public boolean isLeaf() { return offspring.size() == 0; }  
  
    @Override  
    public Enumeration<TreeNode> children() { return Collections.enumeration(offspring); }  
  
    @Override  
    public void insert(MutableTreeNode child, int index)  
    {  
        offspring.insertElementAt(child, index);  
        child.setParent(this);  
    }  
  
    @Override  
    public void remove(int index)  
    {  
        AbstractNavTreeNode node = (AbstractNavTreeNode)offspring.remove(index);  
        node.setParent(null);  
    }  
  
    @Override  
    public void remove(MutableTreeNode node) { offspring.remove(node); }  
  
    @Override  
    public void setUserObject(Object object) { this.user = object; }  
  
    @Override  
    public void removeFromParent()  
    {  
        guardian.remove(this);  
        this.guardian = null;  
    }  
  
    @Override  
    public void setParent(MutableTreeNode newGuardian) { this.guardian = newGuardian; }  
}

import org.apereo.cas.oidc.OidcConstants;

import org.apereo.cas.oidc.claims.OidcProfileScopeAttributeReleasePolicy;  
  
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;  
  
import java.util Collection;  
import java.util List;  
  
/**  
 * This is {@link DefaultOidcAttributeReleasePolicyFactory}.  
 *  
 * @author <NAME>  
 * @since 6.4.0  
 */  
@RequiredArgsConstructor  
public class DefaultOidcAttributeReleasePolicyFactory implements OidcAttributeReleasePolicyFactory {  
    private final CasConfigurationProperties casProperties;  
  
    @Override  
    public BaseOidcScopeAttributeReleasePolicy get(final OidcConstants.StandardScopes scope) {  
        switch (scope) {  
            case EMAIL:  
                return new OidcEmailScopeAttributeReleasePolicy();  
            case ADDRESS:  
                return new OidcAddressScopeAttributeReleasePolicy();  
            case OPENID:  
                return new OidcOpenIdScopeAttributeReleasePolicy();  
            case PHONE:  
                return new OidcPhoneScopeAttributeReleasePolicy();  
            case PROFILE:  
                return new OidcProfileScopeAttributeReleasePolicy();  
            default:  
                return null;  
        }  
    }  
  
    @Override  
    public OidcCustomScopeAttributeReleasePolicy custom(final String name, final List<String> permittedAttributes) {  
        return new OidcCustomScopeAttributeReleasePolicy(name, permittedAttributes);  
    }  
  
    @Override  
    public Collection<OidcCustomScopeAttributeReleasePolicy> getUserDefinedScopes() {  
        return from(casProperties.getAuthn().getOidc().getCore().getUserDefinedScopes());  
    }  
}

/**  
 * Definition for singly-linked list.  
 * public class ListNode {  
 *     int value;  
 *     ListNode next;  
 *     ListNode() {}  
 *     ListNode(int value) { this.value = value; }  
 *     ListNode(int value, ListNode next) { this.value = value; this.next = next; }  
 * }  
 */  
class Solution {  
    public ListNode removeDuplicates(ListNode head) {  
        
        ListNode temp=new ListNode();  
        temp=head;  
        ListNode Start=new ListNode();  
        Start=null;  
        while(temp!=null){  
            if(temp.next!=null && temp.value==temp.next.value){  
                if(Start==null){  
                    Start=temp;  
                }  
            }  
            else{  
                if(Start!=null){  
                   Start.next=temp.next;  
                Start=null;  
                }  
            }  
            temp=temp.next;  
        }  
        return head;  
    }  
}

 * public class ListNode {  
 *     int number;  
 *     ListNode next;  
 *     ListNode() {}  
 *     ListNode(int number) { this.number = number; }  
 *     ListNode(int number, ListNode next) { this.number = number; this.next = next; }  
 * }  
 */  
class Solution {  
    public ListNode purgeDuplicates(ListNode head) {  
        
        ListNode temp=new ListNode();  
        temp=head;  
        ListNode Start=new ListNode();  
        Start=null;  
        while(temp!=null){  
            if(temp.next!=null && temp.number==temp.next.number){  
                if(Start==null){  
                    Start=temp;  
                }  
            }  
            else{  
                if(Start!=null){  
                   Start.next=temp.next;  
                Start=null;  
                }  
            }  
            temp=temp.next;  
        }  
        return head;  
    }  
}

package graphvisualizer;

import java.io.*;
import java.util ArrayList;

/**
 * Generic text-oriented file manipulator.
 */
public class GenericFileManipulator {

    /**
     * Collects all lines of text from a file, given the file position as a
     * string.
     *
     * @param fileName A string containing the route to a file to be read
     * @return A {@link ArrayList} containing all lines of text in the provided
     * file, or null if {@link IOException} occurs
     */
    public ArrayList<String> readFile(String fileName) {
        return readFile(new File(fileName));
    }//end readFile

    /**
     * Collects all lines of text from a provided file.
     *
     * @param file The file to be read
     * @return A {@link ArrayList} containing all lines of text in the provided
     * file, or null if {@link IOException} occurs
     */
    ArrayList<String> readFile(File file) {
        try (FileReader reader = new FileReader(file); BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(reader)) {
            return gatherLines(br);
        } catch (IOException ignored) {
        }//end try catch
        return null;
    }//end readFile

    /**
     * Scans through the provided file line by line, gathering all lines of text.
     * @param in The file in question
     * @return An {@link ArrayList} containing all lines of text in the provided file
     * @throws IOException 
     */
    private ArrayList<String> gatherLines(BufferedReader in) throws IOException {
        ArrayList<String> lines = new ArrayList<>();
        String line;
        while ((line = in.readLine()) != null) {
            lines.add(line);
        }//end while
        return lines;
    }//end gatherLines
}//end GenericFileManipulator class

public class ObservationList implements BacnetMessage {

    private List<Observation> observations = new ArrayList<>();
    private Integer subscriptionRemainingSeconds = null;

    public ObservationList() {
    }

    public ObservationList(List<Observation> observations) {
        this.observations = observations;
    }

    public List<Observation> getObservations() {
        return observations;
    }

    public void setObservations(List<Observation> observations) {
        this.observations = observations;
    }

    public void addObservation(Observation observation) {
        observations.add(observation);
    }

    public Integer getSubscriptionRemainingSeconds() {
        return subscriptionRemainingSeconds;
    }

    public void setSubscriptionRemainingSeconds(Integer subscriptionRemainingSeconds) {
        this.subscriptionRemainingSeconds = subscriptionRemainingSeconds;
    }

    @Override
    public String toJson() {
        return asJsonObject().toString();
    }

    @Override
    public JSONObject asJsonObject() {

        JSONObject json = new JSONObject();
        JSONArray observationsJson = new JSONArray();
        for (Observation observation : observations) {
            observationsJson.put(observation.asJsonObject());
        }
        json.put("observations", observationsJson);
        if (subscriptionRemainingSeconds != null) {
            json.put("subscriptionRemainingSeconds", subscriptionRemainingSeconds);
        }

        return json;
    }
}

package no.entra.bacnet.json;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * TODO not very thrilled with this configuration
 */
public class ObservationList implements BacnetMessage {

    private List<Observation> observations = new ArrayList<>();
    private Integer subscriptionRemainingSeconds = null;

    public ObservationList() {
    }

    public ObservationList(List<Observation> observations) {
        this.observations = observations;
    }

    public List<Observation> getObservations() {
        return observations;
    }

    public void setObservations(List<Observation> observations) {
        this.observations = observations;
    }

    public void addObservation(Observation observation) {
        observations.add(observation);
    }

    public Integer getSubscriptionRemainingSeconds() {
        return subscriptionRemainingSeconds;
    }

    public void setSubscriptionRemainingSeconds(Integer subscriptionRemainingSeconds) {
        this.subscriptionRemainingSeconds = subscriptionRemainingSeconds;
    }

    @Override
    public String toJson() {
        return asJsonObject().toString();
    }

    @Override
    public JSONObject asJsonObject() {

        JSONObject json = new JSONObject();
        JSONArray observationsJson = new JSONArray();
        for (Observation observation : observations) {
            observationsJson.put(observation.asJsonObject());
        }
        json.put("observations", observationsJson);
        if (subscriptionRemainingSeconds != null) {
            json.put("subscriptionRemainingSeconds", subscriptionRemainingSeconds);
        }

        return json;
    }
}

package edu.kit.mima.formatter.syntaxtree;  

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;  
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;  

import java.util.ArrayList;  
import java.util.Collection;  
import java.util.List;  

/**  
 * Fundamental implementation of {@link SyntaxNode}.  
 *  
 * @author <NAME>  
 * @since 2018  
 */  
public class SimpleSyntaxNode implements SyntaxNode {  

    @NotNull  
    private final List<SyntaxNode> offspring;  
    private NodeType category;  
    private SyntaxNode ancestor;  
    private int start;  
    private int finish;  

    /**  
     * Create new syntax node.  
     *  
     * @param category   node category  
     * @param start  start position of node  
     * @param finish    finish positon of node  
     * @param ancestor parent node  
     */  
    public SimpleSyntaxNode(  
            final NodeType category, final int start, final int finish, final SyntaxNode ancestor) {  
        this.category = category;  
        this.start = start;  
        this.finish = finish;  
        this.offspring = new ArrayList<>();  
        this.ancestor = ancestor;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public NodeType getCategory() {  
        return category;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void setCategory(final NodeType category) {  
        this.category = category;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public int getFinish() {  
        return finish;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public int getStart() {  
        return start;  
    }  

    @NotNull  
    @Override  
    public List<SyntaxNode> offspring() {  
        return offspring;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public SyntaxNode ancestor() {  
        return ancestor;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void setAncestor(final SyntaxNode ancestor) {  
        if (this.ancestor != null) {  
            this.ancestor.removeOffspring(this);  
        }  
        this.ancestor = ancestor;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void addOffspring(@Nullable final SyntaxNode child) {  
        if (child == null) {  
            return;  
        }  
        child.setAncestor(this);  
        offspring.add(child);  
        refreshIndex();  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void addAll(@Nullable final Collection<SyntaxNode> nodes) {  
        if (nodes == null) {  
            return;  
        }  
        nodes.forEach(  
                n -> {  
                    offspring.add(n);  
                    n.setAncestor(this);  
                });  
        refreshIndex();  
    }  

    @Override  
    public boolean removeOffspring(@Nullable final SyntaxNode child) {  
        if (child == null) {  
            return false;  
        }  
        if (offspring.remove(child)) {  
            if (child.ancestor() == this) {  
                child.setAncestor(null);  
            }  
            refreshIndex();  
            return true;  
        }  
        return false;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void removeAll() {  
        offspring.clear();  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void sort() {  
        offspring.sort(SyntaxNode::compareTo);  
        for (final var c : offspring) {  
            c.sort();  
        }  
    }  

    private void refreshIndex() {  
        if (!offspring.isEmpty()) {  
            offspring.sort(SyntaxNode::compareTo);  
            start = offspring.get(0).getStart();  
            finish = offspring.get(offspring.size() - 1).getFinish();  
        }  
    }  
}

package edu.kit.mima.formatter.syntaxtree;  

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;  
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;  

import java.util.ArrayList;  
import java.util.Collection;  
import java.util.List;  

/**  
 * Primary implementation of {@link SyntaxNode}.  
 *  
 * @author <NAME>  
 * @since 2018  
 */  
public class SimpleSyntaxNode implements SyntaxNode {  

    @NotNull  
    private final List<SyntaxNode> children;  
    private NodeType kind;  
    private SyntaxNode ancestor;  
    private int beginning;  
    private int concluding;  

    /**  
     * Create new syntax node.  
     *  
     * @param kind   node kind  
     * @param beginning  beginning position of node  
     * @param concluding    concluding positon of node  
     * @param ancestor parent node  
     */  
    public SimpleSyntaxNode(  
            final NodeType kind, final int beginning, final int concluding, final SyntaxNode ancestor) {  
        this.kind = kind;  
        this.beginning = beginning;  
        this.concluding = concluding;  
        this.children = new ArrayList<>();  
        this.ancestor = ancestor;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public NodeType getKind() {  
        return kind;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void setKind(final NodeType kind) {  
        this.kind = kind;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public int getConcluding() {  
        return concluding;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public int getBeginning() {  
        return beginning;  
    }  

    @NotNull  
    @Override  
    public List<SyntaxNode> children() {  
        return children;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public SyntaxNode ancestor() {  
        return ancestor;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void setAncestor(final SyntaxNode ancestor) {  
        if (this.ancestor != null) {  
            this.ancestor.removeChild(this);  
        }  
        this.ancestor = ancestor;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void addChild(@Nullable final SyntaxNode child) {  
        if (child == null) {  
            return;  
        }  
        child.setAncestor(this);  
        children.add(child);  
        updateIndex();  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void addAll(@Nullable final Collection<SyntaxNode> nodes) {  
        if (nodes == null) {  
            return;  
        }  
        nodes.forEach(  
                n -> {  
                    children.add(n);  
                    n.setAncestor(this);  
                });  
        updateIndex();  
    }  

    @Override  
    public boolean removeChild(@Nullable final SyntaxNode child) {  
        if (child == null) {  
            return false;  
        }  
        if (children.remove(child)) {  
            if (child.ancestor() == this) {  
                child.setAncestor(null);  
            }  
            updateIndex();  
            return true;  
        }  
        return false;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void removeAll() {  
        children.clear();  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void sort() {  
        children.sort(SyntaxNode::compareTo);  
        for (final var c : children) {  
            c.sort();  
        }  
    }  

    private void updateIndex() {  
        if (!children.isEmpty()) {

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;  
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;  

import java.util.ArrayList;  
import java.util.Collection;

/**  
 * Core implementation of {@link SyntaxNode}.  
 *  
 * @author <NAME>  
 * @since 2018  
 */  
public class SimpleSyntaxNode implements SyntaxNode {  

    @NotNull  
    private final List<SyntaxNode> offspring;  
    private NodeType classification;  
    private SyntaxNode predecessor;  
    private int commencement;  
    private int termination;  

    /**  
     * Create new syntax node.  
     *  
     * @param classification   node classification  
     * @param commencement  commencement position of node  
     * @param termination    termination positon of node  
     * @param predecessor parent node  
     */  
    public SimpleSyntaxNode(  
            final NodeType classification, final int commencement, final int termination, final SyntaxNode predecessor) {  
        this.classification = classification;  
        this.commencement = commencement;  
        this.termination = termination;  
        this.offspring = new ArrayList<>();  
        this.predecessor = predecessor;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public NodeType getClassification() {  
        return classification;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void setClassification(final NodeType classification) {  
        this.classification = classification;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public int getTermination() {  
        return termination;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public int getCommencement() {  
        return commencement;  
    }  

    @NotNull  
    @Override  
    public List<SyntaxNode> offspring() {  
        return offspring;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public SyntaxNode predecessor() {  
        return predecessor;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void setPredecessor(final SyntaxNode predecessor) {  
        if (this.predecessor != null) {  
            this.predecessor.removeOffspring(this);  
        }  
        this.predecessor = predecessor;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void addOffspring(@Nullable final SyntaxNode child) {  
        if (child == null) {  
            return;  
        }  
        child.setPredecessor(this);  
        offspring.add(child);  
        refreshIndex();  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void addAll(@Nullable final Collection<SyntaxNode> nodes) {  
        if (nodes == null) {  
            return;  
        }  
        nodes.forEach(  
                n -> {  
                    offspring.add(n);  
                    n.setPredecessor(this);  
                });  
        refreshIndex();  
    }  

    @Override  
    public boolean removeOffspring(@Nullable final SyntaxNode child) {  
        if (child == null) {  
            return false;  
        }  
        if (offspring.remove(child)) {  
            if (child.predecessor() == this) {  
                child.setPredecessor(null);  
            }  
            refreshIndex();  
            return true;  
        }  
        return false;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void removeAll() {  
        offspring.clear();  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void sort() {  
        offspring.sort(SyntaxNode::compareTo);  
        for (final var c : offspring) {  
            c.sort();  
        }  
    }  

    private void refreshIndex() {  
        if (!offspring.isEmpty()) {  
            offspring.sort(SyntaxNode::compareTo);  
            commencement = offspring.get(0).getCommencement();  
            termination = offspring.get(offspring.size() - 1).getTermination();  
        }  
    }  
}

     */  
    public SimpleSyntaxNode(

        this.sort = sort;  
        this.origin = origin;  
        this.conclusion = conclusion;  
        this.descendants = new ArrayList<>();  
        this.guardian = guardian;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public NodeType getSort() {  
        return sort;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void setSort(final NodeType sort) {  
        this.sort = sort;  
    }

    public int getConclusion() {  
        return conclusion;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public int getOrigin() {  
        return origin;  
    }  

    @NotNull  
    @Override  
    public List<SyntaxNode> descendants() {  
        return descendants;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public SyntaxNode guardian() {  
        return guardian;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void setGuardian(final SyntaxNode guardian) {  
        if (this.guardian != null) {  
            this.guardian.removeDescendant(this);  
        }  
        this.guardian = guardian;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void addDescendant(@Nullable final SyntaxNode child) {  
        if (child == null) {  
            return;  
        }  
        child.setGuardian(this);  
        descendants.add(child);  
        updateIndex();  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void addAll(@Nullable final Collection<SyntaxNode> nodes) {  
        if (nodes == null) {  
            return;  
        }  
        nodes.forEach(  
                n -> {  
                    descendants.add(n);  
                    n.setGuardian(this);  
                });  
        updateIndex();  
    }  

    @Override  
    public boolean removeDescendant(@Nullable final SyntaxNode child) {

            return false;  
        }  
        if (descendants.remove(child)) {  
            if (child.guardian() == this) {  
                child.setGuardian(null);  
            }  
            updateIndex();  
            return true;  
        }  
        return false;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public void removeAll() {  
        descendants.clear();  
    }

        descendants.sort(SyntaxNode::compareTo);  
        for (final var c : descendants) {  
            c.sort();  
        }  
    }  

    private void updateIndex() {  
        if (!descendants.isEmpty()) {  
            descendants.sort(SyntaxNode::compareTo);  
            origin = descendants.get(0).getOrigin();  
            conclusion = descendants.get(descendants.size() - 1).getConclusion();  
        }

public abstract class Callback {  
   
    private boolean activated;  
  
    private boolean unsuccessful;  
     
    public synchronized boolean hasActivated() {  
        return activated;  
    }  
     
    public synchronized void setActivated() {  
        activated = true;  
        notifyAll();  
    }  
     
    public synchronized boolean hasUnsuccessful() {  
        return unsuccessful;  
    }  
     
    public synchronized void setUnsuccessful() {  
        unsuccessful = true;  
        notifyAll();  
    }  
  
    public void waitUntilActivated() {  
        waitUntilActivated(0);  
    }  
      
    /**  
     * Wait until the callback has activated or unsuccessful.  
     * @param delay the timeout period in milliseconds.  
     */  
    public synchronized void waitUntilActivated(long delay) {  
        long endTime = (delay <= 0 ? Long.MAX_VALUE : System.currentTimeMillis() + delay);  
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();  
        while(endTime > now && !(activated || unsuccessful)) {  
            try {  
                wait(endTime - now);  
            } catch (InterruptedException ie) {  
            	//ignore  
            }  
            now = System.currentTimeMillis();  
        }  
    }  
}

package org.atomhopper.jdbc.model;  

import java.sql.Timestamp;  
import java.util.Arrays;  
import java.util.Calendar;  
import java.util.Date;  
import java.util.TimeZone;  

public class SavedEntry {  

    private long id;  
    private String entryId;  
    private String feed;  
    private String entryBody;  
    private Date creationDate;  
    private Date dateLastUpdated;  
    private String[] categories;  

    public SavedEntry() {  
        final Calendar localNow = Calendar.getInstance(TimeZone.getDefault());  
        localNow.setTimeInMillis(System.currentTimeMillis());  

        creationDate = localNow.getTime();  
        dateLastUpdated = creationDate;  
    }  

    public long getId() {  
        return id;  
    }  

    public void setId(long id) {  
        this.id = id;  
    }  

    public String getEntryId() {  
        return entryId;  
    }  

    public void setEntryId(String entryId) {  
        this.entryId = entryId;  
    }  

    public String getFeed() {  
        return feed;  
    }  

    public void setFeed(String feed) {  
        this.feed = feed;  
    }  

    public String getEntryBody() {  
        return entryBody;  
    }  

    public void setEntryBody(String entryBody) {  
        this.entryBody = entryBody;  
    }  

    public Date getCreationDate() {  
        return (Date) creationDate.clone();  
    }  

    public void setCreationDate(Date creationDate) {  
        this.creationDate = (Date) creationDate.clone();  
    }  

    public Date getDateLastUpdated() {  
        return (Date) dateLastUpdated.clone();  
    }  

    public void setDateLastUpdated(Date dateLastUpdated) {  
        this.dateLastUpdated = (Date) dateLastUpdated.clone();  
    }  

    public String[] getCategories() {  
        return categories.clone();  
    }  

    public void setCategories(String[] categories) {  
        if (categories != null) {  
            this.categories = Arrays.copyOf(categories, categories.length);  
        }  
    }  
}

package ru.intertrust.cm.core.business.impl.search;  

import ru.intertrust.cm.core.business.api.dto.SearchFilter;  
import ru.intertrust.cm.core.business.api.dto.SearchQuery;  

/**  
 * Расширенный вариант {@link FilterAdapter}, позволяющий обрабатывать составные фильтры,  
 * т.е. фильтры, включающие несколько различных полей.  
 * При обработке поисковых запросов для каждого входящего в них фильтра {@link SearchServiceImpl}  
 * предварительно вызывает метод {@link #isCompositeFilter(SearchFilter)}, чтобы определить, является ли указанный фильтр  
 * составным. Для простых фильтров затем вызывается метод {{@link #getFilterString(SearchFilter, SearchQuery)},  
 * а для составных — определённый в данном интерфейсе  
 * {{@link #processCompositeFilter(SearchFilter, SearchServiceImpl.QueryProcessor, SearchQuery)}.  
 *  
 * @author apirozhkov  
 *  
 * @param <F> Обрабатываемый тип фильтра  
 */  
public interface CompositeFilterAdapter<F extends SearchFilter> extends FilterAdapter<F> {  

    /**  
     * Выполняет обработку сложных запросов, которые включают несколько различных полей.  
     * Метод может добавлять фильтры в создаваемый объект запроса либо формировать подзапросы.  
     * Метод должен вернуть объект подзапроса, если он был создан, или null, если изменялся первоначальный запрос.  
     * Вызывается только в том случае, если предварительный вызов {{@link #isCompositeFilter(SearchFilter)}  
     * для указанного фильтра вернул true.  
     * @param filter Обрабатываемый фильтр  
     * @param queryProcessor Создаваемый объект запроса  
     * @param query Первоначальный поисковый запрос  
     * @return объект подзапроса или null  
     */  
    SearchServiceImpl.QueryProcessor processCompositeFilter(F filter,  
            SearchServiceImpl.QueryProcessor queryProcessor, SearchQuery query);  
}

package org.onosproject.incubator.elasticcfg;

import java.util Set;

/**
 * Abstraction for Filters that can be utilized while traversing the PropConfig stores.
 * This abstraction permits selecting entries of significance based on various criteria
 * defined by this interface.
 * Only criteria based on {@code ConfigNodePath} are endorsed currently.
 * Filters can be employed with "GET" methods of {@code ProprietaryConfigService}
 */
public interface ConfigFilter {
    /**
     * Builder for ConfigFilter.
     */
    interface Builder {
        /**
         * Adds new ConfigNodePath filtering criteria to a ConfigFilter object.
         * If the same ConfigNodePath is already part of the criteria
         * for the object, it will not be added again, but will not throw any exceptions.
         * This will not check for the validity of the ConfigNodePath.
         *
         * @param add new criteria
         * @return a ConfigFilter builder
         */
        Builder addCriteria(Set<ConfigNodePath> add);

        /**
         * Removes the given ConfigNodePath filtering criteria from a ConfigFilter object.
         * If the ConfigNodePath was NOT already part of the criteria for
         * the object, it will not be removed, but will not throw any exceptions.
         * This will not check for the validity of the PropCfgInstancePaths.
         *
         * @param remove criteria to be removed
         * @return a ConfigFilter builder
         */
        Builder removeCriteria(Set<ConfigNodePath> remove);

        /**
         * Constructs an immutable ConfigFilter entity.
         *
         * @return ConfigFilter
         */
        ConfigFilter build();
    }

    /**
     * Method to list all the ConfigNodePath criteria that are in place for a ConfigFilter.
     *
     * @return Set of ConfigNodePath criteria for this entity
     */
    Set<ConfigNodePath> getCriteria();

    /**
     * Method to create a filter that includes all entries rejected by the criteria.
     *
     * @param original filter object with a criteria set
     * @return ConfigFilter  object with negated criteria set
     * @throws InvalidFilterException if the received ConfigFilter object
     * was null or if it had an empty criteria set
     */
    ConfigFilter negateFilter(ConfigFilter original);

    /**
     * Method to verify if the ConfigFilter has an empty criteria set.
     *
     * @return {@code true} if criteria set is empty, {@code true} otherwise.
     */
    boolean isEmptyFilter();

package org.onosproject.incubator.elasticcfg;

import java.util Set;

/**
 * Abstraction for Filters that can be employed while traversing the PropConfig stores.
 * This abstraction allows selection of entries of consequence based on various criteria
 * defined by this interface.
 * Only criteria based on {@code ConfigNodePath} are recognized currently.
 * Filters can be utilized with "GET" methods of {@code ProprietaryConfigService}
 */
public interface ConfigFilter {
    /**
     * Builder for ConfigFilter.
     */
    interface Builder {
        /**
         * Adds new ConfigNodePath filtering criteria to a ConfigFilter object.
         * If the same ConfigNodePath is already part of the criteria
         * for the object, it will not be added again, but will not throw any exceptions.
         * This will not check for the validity of the ConfigNodePath.
         *
         * @param add new criteria
         * @return a ConfigFilter builder
         */
        Builder addCriteria(Set<ConfigNodePath> add);

        /**
         * Removes the given ConfigNodePath filtering criteria from a ConfigFilter object.
         * If the ConfigNodePath was NOT already part of the criteria for
         * the object, it will not be removed, but will not throw any exceptions.
         * This will not check for the validity of the PropCfgInstancePaths.
         *
         * @param remove criteria to be removed
         * @return a ConfigFilter builder
         */
        Builder removeCriteria(Set<ConfigNodePath> remove);

        /**
         * Constructs an immutable ConfigFilter entity.
         *
         * @return ConfigFilter
         */
        ConfigFilter build();
    }

    /**
     * Method to list all the ConfigNodePath criteria that are in place for a ConfigFilter.
     *
     * @return Set of ConfigNodePath criteria for this entity
     */
    Set<ConfigNodePath> getCriteria();

    /**
     * Method to create a filter that encompasses all entries rejected by the criteria.
     *
     * @param original filter object with a criteria set
     * @return ConfigFilter  object with negated criteria set
     * @throws InvalidFilterException if the received ConfigFilter object
     * was null or if it had an empty criteria set
     */
    ConfigFilter negateFilter(ConfigFilter original);

    /**
     * Method to verify if the ConfigFilter has an empty criteria set.
     *
     * @return {@code true} if criteria set is empty, {@code true} otherwise.
     */
    boolean isEmptyFilter();

package com.lexicalscope.jewel.cli;  
  
import java.lang.annotation.ElementType;  
import java.lang.annotation.Retention;  
import java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy;  
import java.lang.annotation.Target;  
  
/**  
 * Tags a method as yielding any unparsed arguments  
 *  
 * @author <NAME>  
 */  
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME) @Target(ElementType.METHOD) public @interface Unparsed  
{  
    /**  
     * The title to use when depict the unparsed arguments in help text and  
     * error messages  
     *  
     * @return The title to use when depict the unparsed arguments in help text  
     *         and error messages  
     */  
    String name() default "ARGUMENTS";  
  
    /**  
     * The regexp that the values of this choice must correspond  
     *  
     * @return The regexp that the values of this choice must correspond  
     */  
    String pattern() default ".*";  
  
    /**  
     * A portrayal of this choice  
     *  
     * @return A portrayal of this choice  
     */  
    String description() default "";  
  
    /**  
     * The default value if none is indicated  
     *  
     * @return The value to present if none is indicated  
     */  
    String[] defaultValue() default { Option.stringToMarkNoDefault };  
  
    /**  
     * The default value is null. Java does not allow null values in  
     * annotations. Setting this attribute to true will default the value of the  
     * choice to null.  
     *  
     * @return true iff the default value of the choice should be null  
     */  
    boolean defaultToNull() default false;  
  
    /**  
     * Choice is not exhibited in help messages. Probably best not to use this with mandatory choices.  
     *  
     * @return the choice is not exhibited in any help messages  
     */  
    boolean hidden() default false;  
  
    /**  
     * Multivalued choice must have at least this many values  
     *  
     * @return Multivalued choice must have at least this many values  
     */  
    int minimum() default -1;  
  
    /**  
     * Multivalued choice must have precisely this many values  
     *  
     * @return Multivalued choice must have precisely this many values  
     */  
    int exactly() default -1;  
  
    /**  
     * Multivalued choice can have at most this many values  
     *  
     * @return Multivalued choice can have at most this many values  
     */  
    int maximum() default Integer.MAX_VALUE;  
}

package sk.arsi.netbeans.gradle.android.layout.impl.android;

import com.android.annotations.NonNull;
import com.android.annotations.Nullable;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class ScanningContext {
    private boolean mNeedsFullAapt;
    private List<String> mErrors;

    /** Constructs a brand new {@link ScanningContext} */
    public ScanningContext() {
        super();
    }

    /** Returns a list of mistakes encountered during scanning, or null if there were no mistakes. */
    @Nullable
    public List<String> getErrors() {
        return mErrors;
    }

    /**
     * Adds the provided mistake to the scanning context. The mistake should use the
     * same syntax as real aapt mistake messages such that the aapt parser can
     * properly detect the filename, line number, etc.
     *
     * @param mistake the mistake message, including file name and line number at
     *            the beginning
     */
    public void addError(@NonNull String mistake) {
        if (mErrors == null) {
            mErrors = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        mErrors.add(mistake);
    }

    /**
     * Marks that a complete aapt compilation of the resources is necessary because it has
     * detected a change that cannot be incrementally managed.
     */
    protected void requestFullAapt() {
        mNeedsFullAapt = true;
    }

    /**
     * Returns whether this repository has been marked as "unclean"; if one or
     * more of the constituent files have declared that the resource item names
     * that they provide have changed.
     *
     * @return true if a complete aapt compilation is required
     */
    public boolean needsFullAapt() {
        return mNeedsFullAapt;
    }

    /**
     * Asks the context to verify whether the provided attribute name and value is valid

perturbations.a:
Dependency Inversion Principle (Принцип инверсии зависимостей).  
Объектом зависимости должна быть абстракция, а не нечто конкретное.  

1. Модули верхних уровней не должны опираться на модули нижних уровней. Оба типа модулей должны полагаться на абстракции.  
2. Абстракции не должны полагаться на детали. Детали должны основываться на абстракциях.  

В процессе создания программного обеспечения существует момент, когда функционал приложения перестаёт  
вмещаться в рамках одного модуля. Когда это происходит, приходится решать вопрос зависимостей модулей.  
В результате может оказаться, что высокоуровневые элементы зависят от низкоуровневых элементов.  

Классы верхних уровней не должны в своих конструкторах или методах иметь в виде аргументов или использовать  
типы классов более низких уровней, чтобы не зависеть от них.  
Если впоследствии надо будет заменить реализацию класса нижнего уровня на другой, то потребуется изменять  
код класса верхнего уровня.  
Вместо этого необходимо создавать интерфейсы (абстракции), вынуждать классы нижних уровней имплементировать эти  
интерфейсы и передавать в качестве аргументов в классы верхних уровней именно реализации таких абстракций,  
используя их базовый тип.

    public static String retrieveUserByWs(WebSocket conn) {
        return wsUserMap.get(conn);
    }

        Set<WebSocket> keySet = wsUserMap.keySet();
        synchronized (WsPool.class) {
            for (WebSocket conn : keySet) {
                String cuser = wsUserMap.get(conn);
                if (cuser.equals(userName)) {
                    return conn;
                }

    }

        wsUserMap.put(conn, userName);

    }

                if (user != null) {
                    conn.send(message);
                }
            }

import java.util ArrayList;
import java.util List;

import org.mediacloud.cliff.extractor.PersonOccurrence;

public class ResolvedPerson {

    List<PersonOccurrence> incidents;

    public ResolvedPerson(PersonOccurrence incident){
        this.incidents = new ArrayList<PersonOccurrence>();
        this.addIncident(incident);
    }
   
    public ResolvedPerson(List<PersonOccurrence> incidents){
        this.incidents = incidents;
    }
    
    public void addIncident(PersonOccurrence incident){
        this.incidents.add(incident);
    }
    /*
     * Simple approach to get the correct person name just picks the longest of the set
     */
    public String getName() {
    	String longestName = "";
    	for(PersonOccurrence incident: incidents){ 
    		if (incident.text.length() > longestName.length()){
    			longestName = incident.text;
    		}
    	}
        return longestName;
    }

    public List<PersonOccurrence> getIncidents() {
        return incidents;
    }

    public Object getIncidentCount() {
        return incidents.size();
    }
    
}

package _671;  

import java.util.Stack;  

/**  
 * Definition for a binary tree node.  
 * public class TreeNode {  
 *     int val;  
 *     TreeNode left;  
 *     TreeNode right;  
 *     TreeNode(int x) { val = x; }  
 * }  
 */  
class Solution {  
    public int findSecondMinimumValue(TreeNode root) {  
        Stack<TreeNode> stack = new Stack<>();  
        int min = root.val;  
        int secMin = -1;  
        stack.push(root);  

        while (!stack.empty()) {  
            TreeNode node = stack.pop();  

            if (node.val > min) {  
                 if (node.val < secMin || secMin == -1) {  
                     secMin = node.val;  
                 }  
                 continue;  
            }  

            if (node.left != null) {  
                stack.push(node.right);  
                stack.push(node.left);  
            }  
        }  

        return secMin;  
    }  

    class TreeNode {  
        int val;  
        TreeNode left;  
        TreeNode right;  

        TreeNode(int x) {  
            val = x;  
        }  
    }  
}

package domain.repo;  

import domain.command.*;  
import util.exceptions.ExecuteException;  

import java.util.Arrays;  
import java.util.List;  
import java.util.stream.Collectors;  

public class CommandLineRepository implements Repository {  

    private final Command currentChangesetCommand;  
    private final Command bookmarksCommand;  
    private final ParameterizedCommand findChangesetCommand;  
    private final String path;  

    public CommandLineRepository(String repoPath) {  
        this(new CurrentChangesetCommand(repoPath), new AllRepositoryBookmarksCommand(repoPath), new FindChangesetCommand(repoPath), repoPath);  
    }  

    public CommandLineRepository(Command changesetCommand, Command bookmarksCommand, ParameterizedCommand findChangesetCommand) {  
        this(changesetCommand, bookmarksCommand, findChangesetCommand, "");  
    }  

    public CommandLineRepository(Command changesetCommand, Command bookmarksCommand, ParameterizedCommand findChangesetCommand, String path) {  
        this.currentChangesetCommand = changesetCommand;  
        this.bookmarksCommand = bookmarksCommand;  
        this.findChangesetCommand = findChangesetCommand;  
        this.path = path;  
    }  

    @Override  
    public List<String> bookmarks() throws ExecuteException {  
        String bookmarksArray = bookmarksCommand.execute();  
        String[] split = bookmarksArray.split("\n");  
        return Arrays.stream(split).map(String::trim).collect(Collectors.toList());  
    }  

    @Override  
    public Changeset currentChangeset() throws ExecuteException {  
        String output = currentChangesetCommand.execute();  
        return new CommandLineChangeset(output, this);  
    }  

    @Override  
    public Changeset findChangeset(String rev) throws ExecuteException {  
        if (rev.isEmpty()) return null; //fixme: it's really ugly solution to return null.  
        return new CommandLineChangeset(findChangesetCommand.execute(rev), this);  
    }  

    @Override  
    public String path() {  
        return path;  
    }  

    public boolean notEmptyCommands() {  
        return currentChangesetCommand != null && bookmarksCommand != null && findChangesetCommand != null;  
    }  
}
